_readme: The endpoint accepts ONLY persisted queries whose sha256Hash Sony has
whitelisted — arbitrary GraphQL is refused, and an unknown hash returns
'Query <hash> not whitelisted'. Sony rotates these whenever the store
front-end is redeployed, which is why they live in a file rather than in
the binary: a rotation needs an edit here, not a new build.
To refresh a hash: open store.playstation.com in a browser, watch the
network tab for a request to /api/graphql/v1/op, and copy the sha256Hash
from its 'extensions' query parameter for the matching operationName.
Copy this file next to your .env to override it; that copy wins.
